strings.orientation_tooltip: Click an axis to orient the view
strings.settings_note: WGPU APIs (Vulkan, Direct3D 12 and OpenGL) are shown only when the selected GPU provides an adapter capable of creating a device. On Windows, native OpenGL and WGPU OpenGL depend on the GPU assigned to the process by the driver. You can request the high-performance GPU in Windows; the final choice is made by the operating system and driver, without assuming NVIDIA or AMD. The active WGPU device is shown in the status bar. Restart the viewer to apply changes.
strings.about_description: AMI 3D Viewer is a model and frame-trace viewer used to explore and visualize dumps generated by the XXAMI (Android Model Importer) module. AMI 3D Viewer is part of XXAMI DumpAna, the Android Vulkan API resource analyzer, viewer and modifier suite. Created by Kokokuro*
strings.logo_tooltip: Place viewer_logo.png in the res folder next to model_viewer_qt.py or in the res folder inside the application package.
strings.high_perf_scope_exe: The setting will be applied to the viewer executable.
strings.high_perf_scope_python: You are running the viewer from Python: the setting will apply to this interpreter (python.exe/pythonw.exe) and may affect other programs using the same interpreter.
strings.high_perf_saved: Windows saved the high-performance preference. Close and reopen the viewer so the driver can apply it. This preference is vendor-independent (NVIDIA/AMD).
